description: For an actual native arithmetic body \(A(x)\), an older-name bound term \(t\), supplied HA conversions of \(A\) to and from \(A^{\mathsf N}\), and an assumption-free HA certificate of stability of \(V=\exists x(x\le t\land A(x))\), actual HA certificates of \(V\) and \(V^{\mathsf N}\) convert in both directions uniformly in the original finite additional context.
